scope: Post-capture long-audio completion verification; preserves the original HTTP benchmark and its null full-audio rate.
rules: Only complete natural transcription reports with one successful measured request and one successful warmup are eligible.
Pinned image owner config is 30s chunks, 1s search, 1600-sample windows, 16kHz PCM. Qwen3-ASR does not issue a separate language-detection request.
Cut lengths are between 464000 and 476800 frames; count bounds must agree. Both fixed 600s inputs require exactly 21 model requests.
Require exactly five stop/length/abort/error/repetition series for the single engine, nonnegative integer deltas, total exactly 21 and all 21 stop.
Otherwise keep complete-ASR rate and admitted actual token rate null. Missing counters are not substituted with zeros.
Verified audio rate uses original measured HTTP makespan, excluding warmup; token count remains an isolated engine counter including control tokens.
